classification.difficultyReason: Model monthly interest, solve two inequalities and interpret integer payment counts as calendar dates.

content.prompt: An investment of $\$200\,000$ made on the 2nd of January is earning $\$823$ per month in simple interest. The interest is paid into the account on the 1st of each month. Count January of the investment year as month 1; the first interest payment is on 1 February.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Write down an equation for the balance $B$ of the account on the 1st of the $n$th month.

answer.worked:
On 1 February, $n=2$ and one interest payment has been made. On the first day of month $n$, there have been $n-1$ payments.
$$B=200\,000+823(n-1),\qquad n\ge2.$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the last time that the total balance of the account is no more than $\$205\,000$.

answer.short: 31 July of the investment year, immediately before the 1 August interest payment.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}200\,000+823(n-1)&\le205\,000\\823(n-1)&\le5000\\n-1&\le\frac{5000}{823}=6+\frac{62}{823}\end{align*}$$
At most six payments can have been made. The sixth payment is on 1 July, when the balance is $\$204\,938$. The seventh is on 1 August, when it becomes $\$205\,761$. The last qualifying date is therefore 31 July.

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the first time that the balance is greater than $\$215\,000$.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}200\,000+823(n-1)&>215\,000\\823(n-1)&>15\,000\\n-1&>\frac{15\,000}{823}=18+\frac{186}{823}\end{align*}$$
The first qualifying payment count is 19. After 18 payments the balance is $\$214\,814$; after 19 it is $\$215\,637$. The nineteenth payment is on 1 August in the following year.
